title: Cleveland clubs and meeting Art Tatum
summary: In Cleveland he first met Art Tatum and heard Lannie Scott and Pickett before his mother made him return to school.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: Oh, yes. It was larger. Because there were nightclubs around there, man, all kinds of nightclubs. And that's the first time I met Art Tatum. He was playing at a club around there called Valson (PHONETIC) Alley in Cleveland. And him and another pianist very good at the time, Lannie Scott.
Lannie Scott went to New York, didn't he?

Yeah, he played with Jonah Jones for a long time. And they had another piano player around there named Pickett, he married the chi-chi girl, Rose Murphy. He was a fantastic player. He died. He was a good piano player. They all used to play together around there, you know. And this -- my mother came and got me and made me go back to Columbus and finish school.
